name: push-pin
description: A push pin with a broad cap, tapered body and complete pointed stem.
useCase: Identify push pins or pinning physical notes to a board.
misuse: Use a visible label when a tool identifies a product or a specific art material.

16.reason: The cap and tapered body remain open above the full pin stem.

24.reason: The larger pin retains a broad cap and complete pointed stem.
